title: The M3 Scoreboard Gate: Reference Model, Predictor and Accounting
description: Build a reference model, a predictor and an in-order scoreboard fed by two analysis FIFOs, with end-of-test accounting and a drain, then prove it fails on a dropped, wrong, extra and missing result.

steps.title: Step 1: Run the starter and predict
steps.instructions: Run `testbench.sv` as shipped. Predict the verdict first: it ends with `UVM_ERROR :    0` even with `+define+MUT_SUB`, because nothing compares anything. Note the times: the test drops its objection at 235 ns, when request 20 is accepted.

steps.title: Step 2: Reference model and predictor
steps.instructions: TODO 1: write `alu_model()` from the specification table in README.md. TODO 2: in `alu_predictor::write()`, clone the observed request, set the clone's `result` with `alu_model()`, and publish the clone on `ap`; never modify the received item.

steps.title: Step 3: In-order scoreboard on two FIFOs
steps.instructions: TODO 3: give `alu_scoreboard` `exp_export` and `act_export` connected to private `uvm_tlm_analysis_fifo`s, a comparer with `set_threshold(0)`, and a `run_phase` loop: `peek()` the oldest prediction, `get()` the next actual, set it aside if its tag differs, otherwise `try_get()` the prediction and compare with a checked `compare()`. Connect `prd.ap` and `out_agt.out_mon.ap` to the exports in `alu_env`.

steps.title: Step 4: Accounting and the summary line
steps.instructions: TODO 4a/4b: in `check_phase`, report `SCB/MISSING`, `SCB/UNEXPECTED` and `SCB/NO_TRAFFIC`; in `report_phase` and `pre_abort()`, print exactly `SCB_SUMMARY matches=<n> mismatches=<n> pending=<n>`. Never print PASSED.

steps.title: Step 5: Drain without a fixed delay
steps.instructions: TODO 4c: in `phase_ready_to_end`, for the run phase only, once, and only while `exp_fifo` holds a prediction, raise the phase's objection, wait until `exp_fifo` is empty or `max_latency` has passed, then drop it. Run `alu_test`: expect `SCB/DRAIN ... 2 outstanding` at 235 ns and `SCB_SUMMARY matches=20 mismatches=0 pending=0` at 255 ns with `UVM_ERROR :    0`.

steps.title: Step 6: Prove it fails: four mutants
steps.instructions: Run `+define+MUT_DROP` (expect `SCB/MISSING` for tag 3 and `pending=1`), `+define+MUT_SUB` (expect `SCB/MISMATCH` with the comparer's field detail), `+define+MUT_EXTRA` (expect `SCB/UNEXPECTED` for tag 9 and `pending=1`) and `+UVM_TESTNAME=alu_zero_test` (expect `SCB/NO_TRAFFIC`). Every mutant must fail with its own ID.
